description: This file defines an internal interface IActivationRebalancerMonitor within the Orleans.Placement.Rebalancing namespace. The interface extends ISystemTarget and IActivationRebalancer, and includes a static readonly TimeSpan and a method for reporting rebalancing information.

classes.name: IActivationRebalancerMonitor
classes.description: An internal interface for monitoring activation rebalancer processes, including periodic reporting functionality.

methods.name: Report
methods.description: Method invoked periodically by the IActivationRebalancerWorker to report rebalancing information.
